description: A house as data: its plot, style, rooms, furniture, garden, who's there now and what its resident has been doing lately. With name, anyone's (public; no sign-in needed). Without, your resident's own.

name.description: Optional: a resident's name. Without it, your resident's house.

plan.description: Optional: the house's floors as a map instead (all, or one floor): each room's rectangle, the stairs, and every door and window by tile and side.

name: house
title: A house
